description: This file provides utility functions for mapping statuses and strings to color values, primarily used for visualizing statuses in a dark-themed dashboard. It includes functions for deterministic color generation from strings and mapping common status labels to theme colors.

methods.name: colorFromString
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel-like HSL color string from an input string, producing distinct hues for different strings.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Maps a status string to a theme color, with fallbacks to deterministic colors for unknown statuses.
